logarithmic_endpoint.weights: For n>=2 let A_n=1/[n log(n+1)], w_n=(A_n-A_(n+1))/A_2 and epsilon_n=e^(-n); the positive w_n telescope to one.
logarithmic_endpoint.density: With triangular probability densities tau_epsilon, f=sum_(n>=2)w_n tau_(epsilon_n) is compact and L1, and mu=f dx is atom-free and absolutely continuous.
logarithmic_endpoint.annular_transform: widehat mu(t)=sum_n w_n sinc^2(epsilon_n t/2)>=0 and widehat mu(t) is comparable to A_n on I_n=[e^n,e^(n+1)].
logarithmic_endpoint.primitive: For G(x)=mu((x-1,x]), G is nonnegative compact AC and BV, DG=[f(x)-f(x-1)]dx, and it widehat G(t)=(1-e^(-it))widehat mu(t).
logarithmic_endpoint.critical_failure: int |t|log|t||widehat G(t)|^2dt<infinity because sum_n 1/[n log^2 n]<infinity, but int|widehat G(t)|dt=infinity because sum_n 1/[n log n]=infinity.
logarithmic_endpoint.supercritical_sufficiency: For every epsilon>0, low-frequency L2 plus int |t|(log|t|)^(1+epsilon)|widehat G(t)|^2dt<infinity implies widehat G in L1 by weighted Cauchy-Schwarz.
logarithmic_endpoint.scope_guard: This is a sharp logarithmic scale boundary, not a necessary characterization of Fourier L1 and not an electric-field, nonlinear-remainder or source-owned-flow theorem.
